_comment: Mission-executor sandbox policy for pi. Install to ~/.pi/extensions/sandbox.json (global) or $WT/.pi/sandbox.json (per-worktree). Writes are confined to the worktree plus the toolchain caches a Go build genuinely needs — measured, not guessed: with only ['.','/tmp'] a build fails on ~/Library/Caches/go-build. Cache dirs cannot corrupt the repo, so widening to them costs nothing that matters.
